accessibility_and_performance.reduced_motion: Detect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion / window.matchMedia and bypass handwriting SVG & long delays for instant clean fade transitions.
accessibility_and_performance.keyboard_navigation: All profiles, CTAs, and navigation controls are focusable with visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-[#B51F32] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#090909]).
accessibility_and_performance.browser_history: Sync screen state with URL hash or HTML5 History API (#hello, #identity, #profiles, #hero?profile=recruiter) so browser Back/Forward works seamlessly.
accessibility_and_performance.font_loading: Use font-display: swap and pre-calculated line heights to eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 4 screens as a single-page React app with continuous state or React Router integration.
Use Tailwind CSS and inline SVG for the handwriting animation using stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset with exact SVG glyph paths for 'Hello.'
Strictly adhere to the dark crimson palette: #090909, #171719, #B51F32, #D33B4C, #E7E2DF, #A7A2A0.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes as specified.
Do NOT use cartoon avatars, stock photos, or generic SaaS landing page layouts.
